scope: Stage-2 authority, exact pinned tree, README, assembly instruction text and bundled primary paper inspected statically. CAD, video, workbook and hardware were not opened, played, executed or built.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license defines reuse terms despite README and paper wording that the mechanical design is open source.
Assembly instructions retain unresolved screw specifications, tendon-length procedure and silicone-mix ratio.
The README control-interface entry is empty and no control implementation is bundled for the proposed actuators.
Raw compression, interface-loading and motion measurements plus analysis code are not bundled, so paper results cannot be independently recomputed from the repository.
Procurement versions and the complete physical experimental setup are only partially specified and were not validated by a build.

notes: The resource is open hardware rather than PINN software or a reusable research dataset.
